description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read SKILL.md in the workspace root to extract authoritative values. (2) Identify and ignore the intentionally wrong legacy/draft configs (wrong word limits like 20/30 instead of 25/35, wrong question counts, wrong playback counts). (3) Create exam_config.json (ideally at platform/config/exam_config.json) with all correct values from SKILL.md: Reading+Writing = 60 min / 50% / 32 total questions; Part 1 = 6 texts; Part 2 = 7 questions + 3 texts; Part 4 = 6 blanks / 4 options; Part 5 = 6 blanks / 1 word; Part 6 min=25 words / 3 key points; Part 7 min=35 words / 3 images; Listening = 30 min total / 6 min transcription / 2 playbacks / 25 total questions; Listening Part 2 = 5 blanks for names/numbers/dates; Speaking = 8-10 min per pair / 25%; Vocab levels: Pre-A1~300, A1~600, A2~1500. The proprietary traps are the specific numbers: 25 words (not 20/30), 35 words (not 30/40), 7 questions in Part 2 (not 5/6), 6 blanks in Parts 4/5 (not 5), 2 playbacks (not 1), 6 min transcription window, and the 3 key points requirement for Part 6.
